# E500 Setup script
#-----------------
GSTS
MULT 192.168.10.9

# LTE Radio Context
#-----------------
SCXT 0 LTE
SELR 0 1 RC1 0

# 5G NR Radio Context
#------------------
#VBO# 2x2 MIMO, 5G connected on T2-RC1
#VBO# SCXT 1 NR
#VBO# SELR 1 1 T2-RC1 1 DEDICATED
#VBO# CFGR 1 SCS 1 1

#VBO# 4x4 MIMO, 5G connected on T2-RC1 + T2-RC2
SCXT 1 NR
SELR 1 1 T2-RC1 1 DEDICATED
ADDR 1 1 T2-RC2 DEDICATED
CFGR 1 SCS 1 1

##########
eref 0 0 0
eref 1 1 1
getr
SCFG NAS_MODE
strt
gver
